callsign.description: Display callsign exactly as the FCC ULS record has it, uppercase.

normalized_callsign.description: Uppercase, whitespace-stripped callsign. The lookup key -- every query filters on this field.

radio_service.description: Derived from the FCC's radio_service_code: ZA -> GMRS; HA/HV -> HAM.

radio_service_code.description: Raw FCC ULS radio service code (e.g. ZA, HA, HV) -- kept for troubleshooting a misclassification.

license_status_code.description: Raw FCC ULS license status code from HD.dat position 5 (A, C, E, T, etc.).

license_status.description: Normalized from license_status_code + expired_date, for direct use by verification.

active.description: true only when license_status is 'active'. Indexed shortcut so the verification path doesn't need to interpret the status field.

licensee_name.description: Entity name from EN.dat (last, first for an individual; org name for a club/organization).

unique_system_identifier.description: FCC ULS's own join key across HD.dat/EN.dat/etc for this license. The reconciliation key for updates -- NOT unique across services (GMRS and HAM number from the same sequence), so always pair with radio_service_code when matching.

license_key.description: Stable composite reconciliation key: radio_service_code + ':' + unique_system_identifier. This is the primary identity used by full/daily FCC imports.

last_transaction_date.description: HD.dat's own last-action date within the FCC's data, when present. Distinct from updated_date, which is when Repeater Nation last touched this row.

source.description: Which importer last wrote this row.

source_file.description: e.g. l_gmrs.zip or l_gm_mon.zip -- the specific FCC file this row's data came from.

last_checked_at.description: Last time this row was confirmed against an FCC source (full import or a daily transaction touching it).
